fact: The National Assembly committee advertised in print media on 18 February 2025 for public comments on the Computer Misuse and Cybercrimes (Amendment) Bill 2024, received submissions from the Ministry of ICT, KICTANet and the Kenya Alliance of Residents Associations, and set them out in its April 2025 report.
title: Report on the Consideration of the Computer Misuse and Cybercrimes (Amendment) Bill (National Assembly Bill No. 41 of 2024)
publisher: National Assembly of Kenya, Departmental Committee on Communication, Information and Innovation
